purpose: 이승만 backbone의 1953~1954 원조·외교·안보 조사에서 반복 등장하는 한국 측 비대통령 행위자를 독립 후보 노드로 분리한다. 회의 참석은 개별 정책 제안·승인·집행과 동일시하지 않는다.
sourceFamily: U.S. Department of State, FRUS 1952-1954, Korea XV Part 2

candidates.name: 백두진
actionEvidence: Tasca report expressly thanked Prime Minister Paik for cooperation
1953-12-14 Wood-Paik agreement specified Combined Economic Board operating terms
openLeads: 1953-12-14 Wood-Paik agreement full text and Korean counterpart copy
ROK cabinet/CEB minutes separating Paik personal proposals from institutional positions

candidates.name: 변영태
actionEvidence: 1953-08-07 FRUS records Pyun proposing an additional sovereignty clause during treaty consultations
openLeads: Korean Foreign Ministry draft treaty and instruction files
compare Korean draft clauses with U.S. memoranda of conversation

candidates.name: 손원일
actionEvidence: FRUS records Defense Minister Sohn presenting programs proposed by the three ROK armed services in August 1953
openLeads: ROK Defense Ministry memorandum underlying the three-service program
separate Sohn endorsement from service-level proposals

candidates.name: 임병직
actionEvidence: FRUS participant lists place Limb in the Korean delegation at repeated high-level consultations
openLeads: official Korean diplomatic roster and exact title/date
extract substantive interventions rather than attendance-only evidence

candidates.name: 양유찬
actionEvidence: FRUS July 1954 talks identifies Yang as ROK Ambassador to the United States
openLeads: ROK Embassy dispatches preparing Rhee visit
identify Yang-authored aid/security proposals in State Department files

candidates.name: 최순주
actionEvidence: FRUS lists Dr. Choe Sun-chu in the Korean delegation; Ministry of Finance official history separately identifies Choi Sun-ju as finance minister Apr 1950-Mar 1951
candidates.identityCaution: romanization and identity should be cross-checked in Korean delegation records before merging all 1954 interventions
openLeads: Korean delegation roster confirming Dr. Choe Sun-chu = 崔淳周
determine delegation portfolio and substantive interventions

candidates.name: 정일권
actionEvidence: FRUS July 1954 meetings list General Chung Il-kwon among Korean participants
openLeads: confirm exact July 1954 office from Korean military personnel orders
extract military-subcommittee statements attributable to Chung

candidates.name: 김정렬
actionEvidence: FRUS July 1954 meetings list General Kim Chong-yol among Korean participants
openLeads: confirm exact July 1954 command from Korean Air Force personnel records
locate air-force program submitted to U.S. military subcommittee

candidates.name: 최덕신
actionEvidence: FRUS July 1954 meetings list General Choe Tok-sin among Korean participants
openLeads: confirm exact July 1954 office and delegation portfolio
extract any authored military planning paper or statement

candidates.name: 원용덕
actionEvidence: FRUS July 1954 talks explicitly discuss General Won Yong Duk's warning to Communist NNSC members to leave the ROK
openLeads: recover Korean text and issuing authority of Won warning
determine whether warning was independently issued or authorized by higher civilian authority

supports: Won Yong Duk NNSC warning discussion

attributionRules: participant-list presence proves attendance/representation only, not proposal or approval
U.S. memorandum characterization is contemporaneous observation, not automatically Korean institutional record
military-service program proposals must be separated from Defense Minister presentation and presidential approval
later officeholding must not be projected backward into 1953-1954 roles
